name: Láchar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Láchar (a castle and a crescent on green, ears of wheat and waves).
history: The municipality of Láchar has had its own arms and flag since 2002, when they were approved by the council in plenary; since they were never entered in the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales they lack official status, although this does not prevent their widespread use.

features.role: Láchar arms — castle, crescent, ears of wheat and waves
